name: Miyou
source:
Ramon first meets Pomelo and Orchid in the kitchen facilities on Hive Island. Quick on her feet, she not only is skilled as a chef, she also helps out with laundry duty for the sentries who stand guard on the island. She seems really close to Orchid.

[From the [url=https://twitter.com/sekaiproject/status/1261793618962063366]official Twitter account[/url]]
